summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj filed a Form 6-K attaching a stock exchange release about the subscription of 577,237 new shares via warrant exercise by Kreos Capital. The warrants, issued December 23, 2025, allowed for up to 1,015,511 shares; Kreos exercised all outstanding warrants through net exercise, paying EUR 0.01 per share, with proceeds to the reserve for invested unrestricted equity. No warrants remain. The new shares were registered with the Finnish Trade Register and will trade on Nasdaq Helsinki. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
